name: White pudding
definition: cooked sausage of pork, fat and oatmeal or other grain, without blood, sliced or heated to eat.
notes: Clonakilty Irish White Pudding: pork, oatmeal, onions, no blood; grilled in slices.

name: Half-moon edger (edging iron)
definition: long-handled tool with a flat half-moon blade pushed in by foot to cut a clean lawn edge.
notes: Burgon & Ball RHS Stainless Steel Half Moon Lawn Edger, ash handle, serrated head.

name: Broadfork
definition: two-handled wide fork with long tines, rocked back to loosen soil deeply without turning it.
notes: Broad Fork with 12in and 14in tines sold by Meadow Creatures.

name: Grass shears
definition: shears with short blades, one-handed or on long handles, for trimming grass at lawn edges by hand.
notes: Wilkinson Sword Long Handled Lawn Shears in grass shears range; 820mm handles.

name: Garden tiller (rotavator)
definition: powered machine with rotating tines that digs and breaks up soil for beds and plots.
notes: Tillers listed: Garden Weasel Tiller/Cultivator, Mantis Tiller with 2- or 4-cycle engine.

name: Hose spray gun (hose nozzle)
definition: hand-held nozzle or gun fitted to a hose end to shape and stop the water jet for hand watering.
notes: Hozelock Multi Plus Spray Gun sold as hose spray attachment.

name: Hose connector (hose fitting)
definition: click-on or screw connector, tap connector or coupling that joins garden hoses to taps, tools and each other.
notes: Hozelock hose end connectors, repair connectors and tap connectors sold.

name: Water lily (Nymphaea)
definition: living hardy or tropical water lily of the genus Nymphaea sold to grow in a pond or tub.
notes: Hardy Nymphaea sold bare root, e.g. Nymphaea 'Cynthia Ann'.

name: Lotus (Nelumbo)
definition: living lotus of the genus Nelumbo sold as a tuber or potted plant to grow in water.
notes: Nelumbo nucifera sold as dormant tuber; Lotus is its own shop category.

name: Bone folder
definition: Smooth flat tool made for creasing and folding paper in bookbinding and card making.
notes: TALAS genuine bone folders, three shapes, for creasing, scoring and burnishing paper.

name: DECT repeater
definition: unit that extends the range of a cordless (DECT) phone's base station to its handsets.
notes: AVM FRITZ!DECT Repeater 100 extends DECT phone range; works with GAP base stations.

name: Earbud charging case
definition: Replacement charging case made for one model of true wireless earbuds.
notes: Samsung charging case sold alone as replacement for Galaxy Buds+ and Buds.

name: Dryer sheet
definition: non-woven sheet carrying softener and scent, tumbled with laundry in a dryer.
notes: Bounce Fresh Linen dryer sheets: softener sheet added to the dryer, 80 ct box.

name: Crease-release and ironing spray
definition: spray (crease releaser, starch or ironing water) that relaxes creases or eases ironing.
notes: Downy Wrinkle Releaser spray smooths wrinkles; used like spray starch when ironing.

name: PV combiner box
definition: enclosure that joins several solar panel strings into one output, with fuses or breakers, made for a PV array.
notes: Combiner Boxes & Breakers category; Midnite MNPV3, MNPV6 and OutBack FWPV8 PV combiners.

name: Battery-bank charger
definition: mains- or generator-fed charger made to charge a home or off-grid battery bank.
notes: Battery Chargers category: Iota DLS, Victron BlueSmart, EG4 Chargeverter, Cotek; 12-48V.

name: Battery enclosure
definition: box or cabinet made to house the cells or modules of a home or off-grid battery bank.
notes: Battery Enclosures category: DPW pole-mount boxes, Midnite MNBE-D steel battery box.

name: Swim spa
definition: long hard-shell spa with a swim current, heated and filtered like a hot tub, for swimming in place.
notes: Jacuzzi swim spa: swim in place against jet current, doubles as hot tub; unlike a pool.

name: Loose incense [bakhoor]
definition: scented wood chips, resin or powder burned on charcoal or a heater to scent a room (rite incense is F4).
notes: Bakhoor Aroma Chips 200g pouch burned in incense burner; chips on charcoal or electric burner.

name: Deep fryer
definition: appliance that cooks food immersed in hot oil in a thermostatic tank or basket
notes: Hendi Countertop Electric Fryer 4 L, thermostat 50-190C, in Deep Fryers category.

name: Microwave oven
definition: enclosed appliance that heats food with microwaves; combination microwave ovens included
notes: K's Denki category 電子レンジ: Haier, Panasonic, Sharp, Toshiba, Balmuda single-function ranges.

name: Blender
definition: appliance with a jar and fast spinning blade that purees, blends and crushes food and drink
notes: Vitamix Ascent 3500i listed as ミキサー・ブレンダー countertop blender.

name: Ladle
definition: deep-bowled long-handled spoon for serving and pouring soup, sauce and liquid
notes: OXO Good Grips silicone set includes a Ladle for scooping and serving.

name: Cooking spoon
definition: long-handled spoon for stirring and serving in cooking, solid or slotted; table spoons are B5.4.2.02
notes: OXO silicone set includes a Cooking Spoon to stir sauce and break up meat.

name: Wreckfish [stone bass; cherne]
definition: Raw wreckfish Polyprion americanus, sold whole, in pieces or as fillets.
notes: Santa Monica Seafood sheet: wreckfish Polyprion americanus, also known as stone bass; forms not stated.

name: Wall sign or plaque
definition: flat sign or plaque made to fix to or stand against a wall.
notes: Nostalgic-Art Metal Hanging Sign, steel, 10x20cm, sold as wall decor.
